Documentation for the Stata commands written by
[Trenton D. Mize](https://www.trentonmize.com). Each command has its own set
of pages; installation instructions are on each overview page.

::: {.command-table}
| Command | What it does |
|:------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| [**mecompare**](mecompare/index.html) | Marginal effects, and tests of whether an effect differs across models: nested models, alternative predictors, different outcomes, different model types, separate groups. |
| [**suest2**](suest2/index.html) | Combines separately estimated models so that quantities from different models can be tested against each other. |
| [**metest**](metest/index.html) | Tests contrasts between rows of the tables produced by `mecompare`, `meinequality`, and `totalme`. |
| [**meinequality**](meinequality/index.html) | Summarizes how unequal the marginal effects of a categorical predictor are across its categories. |
| [**totalme**](totalme/index.html) | Summarizes a predictor's effect across all outcome categories of a multiple-outcome model in a single Total Marginal Effect. |
| [**balanceplot**](balanceplot/index.html) | Plots and tabulates standardized covariate imbalance across groups, for a continuous treatment, and before and after matching or weighting. |
| [**sgmediation2**](sgmediation2/index.html) | Sobel-Goodman tests of statistical mediation in linear regression, with survey weights, multiply imputed data, and bootstrapping. |
| [**irt_me**](irt_me/index.html) | Marginal effects of the latent variable on each item after item response theory models. |
| [**irt_coef**](irt_coef/index.html) | y*-standardized coefficients for binary and ordinal item response theory models. |
| [**lca_entropy**](lca_entropy/index.html) | Entropy fit statistic for latent class analysis models fit with `gsem`. |
| [**desctable**](desctable/index.html) | Formatted descriptive statistics tables, exported to Excel, with continuous, binary, and nominal variables each treated appropriately. |
| [**cleanplots**](cleanplots/index.html) | A graphics scheme that makes Stata graphs clean, colorblind friendly, and printable in black and white; ordinal palettes included. |
| [**usetdm**](usetdm/index.html) | Loads the example datasets for classes, workshops, and replication files from the web. |
:::

The R packages, including the R version of `cleanplots`, are listed at
[trentonmize.com/software](https://www.trentonmize.com/software).
